{{Quote|There are many ways to die, and as you knew Mak Luunim, you know what happens to beings who choose not to repay their debts to me.|Nal Kenuun, to Luke Skywalker|<ref name="Target" />}}
'''Nal Kenuun''' was a [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who resided in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Pilaan]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]]. He was a wealthy and powerful [[Gambling/Legends|gambler]] who held high-stakes games and participated in illegal [[Podracing/Legends|Podracing]] by sponsoring his own [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], [[Grunta]].

In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], Kenuun captured the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], and [[X-7|Tobin Elad]] after they [[Death/Legends|killed]] Grunta. With an upcoming [[Muunilinst Podrace|race]] looming, Kenuun offered to give the Rebels a [[Datacard/Legends|datacard]] he had taken from [[Mak Luunim]], a Rebel contact whom he had killed due to an unpaid debt, in exchange for one of the Rebels taking Grunta's spot in the competition. Skywalker accepted the arrangement and eventually won the race. However, after the Rebels received the datacard from Kenuun, the Muun tried to collect the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Bounty/Legends|bounties]] on Solo and Elad. When Organa threatened to harm [[Urgiluu]], Kenuun's pet [[Krayt dragon/Legends|krayt dragon]], Kenuun consented to let the Rebels escape without further incident.

==Biography==
===Life on Muunilinst===
{{Quote|He's rich, he's powerful, and he likes to gamble. And no one wants to cross him. That's all I found out.|Luke Skywalker, on Nal Kenuun|<ref name="Target" />}}
Nal Kenuun was a [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who resided in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Pilaan]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]]. Rich and powerful, Kenuun had many individuals in debt to him, including several [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] stationed on the planet, whom he used as his own private guard. Other Muuns were wary of earning his ire, as Kenuun was generally known to have people who offended him [[Death/Legends|killed]]. When fellow Muun [[Mak Luunim]] was unable to pay back his debt to Kenuun, Kenuun arranged his death&mdash;Luunim was killed when his [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder's]] central [[Engine/Legends|turbine]] failed in midair, an action carried out by Kenuun's stormtroopers.<ref name="Target" />

[[File:Muunilinst.jpg|thumb|left|210px|Muunilinst, Nal Kenuun's homeworld.]]
In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="NERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Rebel Force: Target]]'' to [[0 ABY]].</ref> the [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilot]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], accompanied by fellow [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], and Tobin Elad&mdash;who was secretly the Imperial [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[X-7]] tasked to kill Skywalker&mdash;went to Muunilinst in search of Luunim, who had been a Rebel contact managing part of their funds. Luunim, however, was already dead by the [[Time/Legends|time]] that Skywalker and the others arrived.<ref name="Target" />

Having learned that Kenuun had raided [[Mak Luunim's apartment|Luunim's apartment]], taking everything of value, the Rebels concluded that Kenuun was in possession of a [[Mak Luunim's datacard|datacard]] that they had sought to retrieve from Luunim. The datacard contained access codes to secret financial accounts that the Rebellion badly needed to replace its lost funds after the planet [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan's]] [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction]].<ref name="Target" />

While looking for information on how to contact Kenuun, the Rebels were approached by [[Grunta]], a [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] under the employ of Kenuun. Grunta offered to lead the Rebels to a high-stakes [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] game that Kenuun was holding in exchange for a hundred-[[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credit]] fee. However, Grunta turned on the Rebels when he led them into an ambush by four of his fellow Dugs flying [[Swoop/Legends|swoops]] and armed with [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] who tried to rob them. After a short [[Lightfight|fight]], the Rebels were able to drive the robbers away, killing Grunta in the process, but were ambushed again by Kenuun's stormtroopers.<ref name="Target" />

===Muunilinst podrace===
{{Quote|Podracing is illegal. Half the racers end up dead.''"<br />"''Indeed. Poor Grunta was probably lucky to live as long as he did. And certainly this was a more pleasant way to go. Be that as it may, the race goes on. One of you will take Grunta's spot in the race. And you will win. I'll receive my money, you'll receive your datacard.|Princess Leia Organa to Nal Kenuun|<ref name="Target" />}}
Owing to Grunta's penchant for trouble, Kenuun had a [[homing droid]] shadowing him as a precaution, which enabled Kenuun's stormtroopers to find and capture the Rebels. They were taken to [[Nal Kenuun's apartment|Kenuun's home]], where, after being restrained by [[Stuncuffs/Legends|stun cuffs]] in a makeshift [[Prison/Legends|prison]] for a certain length of time, they were finally able to meet Kenuun.<ref name="Target" />

[[File:LukeESB-OP.png|thumb|right|210px|Luke Skywalker, who offered to be Nal Kenuun's podracing pilot.]]
Their captor inquired why they were keen to meet him, and, after learning their reasons, Kenuun admitted that he did have Luunim's datacard. In exchange for it, however, the Muun demanded that one of them take Grunta's place and race for Kenuun in an upcoming [[Muunilinst Podrace|Podrace event]]. When the Rebels pointed out that [[Podracing/Legends|Podracing]] was not suited for a [[Human/Legends|Human]], Kenuun warned them of the fate of individuals who chose not to repay their debts to him, subtly reminding them of Luunim's death. Eventually, Skywalker agreed to the proposition and volunteered himself.<ref name="Target" />

Kenuun lent Skywalker [[Grunta's Podracer]], a [[Collor Pondrat/Legends|Collor Pondrat]] [[Plug-2 Behemoth|Plug-2 ''Behemoth'']]. While Skywalker was testing the Podracer, one of its [[Engine/Legends|engines]] caught [[Fire/Legends|fire]] due to a defective [[current filter]], and Skywalker lost control of the craft, which crashed into the ground and subsequently exploded. Unhurt and determined to win the competition, Skywalker convinced Kenuun to lend him another one. Similarly bent on winning, Kenuun allowed Skywalker to choose another [[Nal Kenuun's Podracer|Podracer]]&mdash;a [[Keizar-Volvec/Legends|Keizar-Volvec]] [[9T9-B Wasp/Legends|KV9T9-B ''Wasp'']]&mdash;from his vast collection. After a close race, Skywalker emerged as the winner, beating the other Podracer pilots sponsored by Kenuun's Muun rivals.<ref name="Target" />

===Betraying the Rebels===
{{Quote|Urgiluu! What have you done to her?''"<br />"''Nothing Yet.|Nal Kenuun to Princess Leia Organa|<ref name="Target" />}}
[[File:LeiaOrgana-TSS.jpg|thumb|left|210px|Princess Leia Organa, who threatened to harm Nal Kenuun's pet.]]
When Skywalker, Solo, and Elad went back to Kenuun's apartment to collect their end of the deal, Kenuun proved true to his word and handed the datacard over to the Rebels. As they tried to leave, however, Kenuun summoned his stormtroopers and then tried to collect the Imperial [[Bounty/Legends|bounties]] on Solo and Elad as payment for the first Podracer that Skywalker crashed. The ensuing fight ended in a standoff, in which one of the stormtroopers leveled a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] on Solo, while Elad raised one on Kenuun.<ref name="Target" />

To break the stalemate, Elad offered himself to Kenuun in exchange for Solo's and Skywalker's safety. Kenuun agreed to the proposition when Organa suddenly appeared and declared a new agreement by threatening to harm Kenuun's pet [[Krayt dragon/Legends|krayt dragon]], [[Urgiluu]]. Fearing that the [[Krayt dragon pearl/Legends|krayt dragon pearl]] inside Urgiluu's [[Stomach/Legends|stomach]] might be damaged and lessen its value, Kenuun allowed the Rebels to leave Muunilinst safely.<ref name="Target" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Everyone knows that Kenuun loves nothing in this galaxy except his baby krayt dragon. The whole planet's laughing about it behind his back. Of course, the last one foolish enough to laugh in front of him learned his lesson.|Haari Ikreme Beeerd|<ref name="Target" />}}
A typical Muun, though considerably taller and slimmer compared to others of his kind, Nal Kenuun was very particular when it came to monetary matters, deeming it dishonorable to renege or go back on one's word concerning financial dealings. True to his Muun heritage, Kenuun never let opportunities for certain financial gain pass him by<ref name="Target" />

Kenuun was fastidious regarding his possessions, never failing to demand a replacement or suitable payment in the instances in which his properties were destroyed. When his Podracer pilot, Grunta, was killed by Han Solo and his fellow Rebels, Kenuun threatened to murder them unless someone took Grunta's place in the race, as Kenuun claimed Grunta to be his property. After Luke Skywalker won the Podracing event, the Muun remained true to his word and handed over the datacard that he had promised to the Rebels. It was only after the exchange was made that he tried to collect the Imperial bounty on Solo and Tobin Elad.<ref name="Target" />

Kenuun had a reputation for being cold-[[Heart/Legends|hearted]] and cruel, which made his attachment to his pet krayt dragon all the more humorous to his Muun rivals, who mocked Kenuun behind his back. However, what his rivals did not know was that Kenuun held no affection for the creature but was more interested in harvesting the valuable pearl that the dragon had in its stomach.<ref name="Target" />

Inspiring fear in everyone who knew him, Kenuun arranged the deaths of beings for reasons varying from not paying their debts to him to the simplest matter of angering him. According to [[Haari Ikreme Beeerd]], a Podracing crewman whom Solo befriended prior to the race, an individual once laughed in front of Kenuun upon learning the Muun's devotion to his pet. As reprisal, the individual was killed along with his entire family. However, being smart and calculating, Kenuun ensured that no proof was ever found tying himself to the murders.<ref name="Target" />

==Skills and abilities==
{{Quote|Yes, you will stay. And you will certainly race again. But next time, you may not survive. Leaving the debt unpaid. A bounty, on the other hand, is certain to line my pockets with credits. I may be a gambler when it suits me&mdash;but it's not the way of the Muun to pass up opportunities for sure financial gain.|Nal Kenuun|<ref name="Target" />}}
Nal Kenuun was extremely analytical and tended to view all possible outcomes of a situation in order to boost his own advancement and interests. Being the most feared individual on the planet, Kenuun was efficient in handling all of his organization's affairs, whether it be employing stormtroopers to eliminate a rival, or choosing the best pilots to race for him.<ref name="Target" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nal Kenuun was created by author [[Alex Wheeler]] for the [[2008]] novel ''[[Rebel Force: Target]]'', the first entry in the ''[[Star Wars: Rebel Force]]'' series.<ref name="Target" />
